purpose: The 10 test accounts for the pilot dry run (#168), fixed as data so the seed, the smoke suite and the evidence template cannot disagree about which account is supposed to do what. Trained adult staff and synthetic text only - no real high-school student is put through a path that has not been proven here first.
notes: Every account uses synthetic journal text. None of it describes a real person.
`expected_terminal_state` is the pilot_enrollments.state the account should end in. An account that reaches a different state is a finding, not a variation.
`must_be_zero` lists counts that have to be exactly 0 for that account. A non-zero is a No-Go item unless the research lead records an accepted P1 with a reason and a date.
Account 10 exercises the crisis runbook with synthetic text. The staff member running it knows it is an exercise; the point is to time the human path, not to test a detector.
